title: Veal Mozzarella
description: Veal wrapped with mushroom, bacon, and shallots in puff pastry, topped with melted mozzarella. A Wellington-style preparation from the bistro kitchen.

method.instruction: Pan-fry veal briefly in a little butter over high heat — just seared on both sides, not fully cooked as it will finish in the oven. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, fry bacon and onion in butter until softened and the bacon is crisp. Add mushrooms and cook until golden, about 3–4 minutes.
Add half the demi glace to the mushroom mixture and stir to bind. Season with salt. Allow to cool slightly.
Lay puff pastry sheet flat. Place each seared veal escalope on the pastry, top with the mushroom and bacon mixture, and wrap the pastry tightly around to form a parcel. Seal edges with egg wash.
Brush the top generously with egg wash. Place on a lined baking tray and bake at 200°C for 12–15 minutes until the pastry is golden and puffed.
In the last 3–4 minutes of baking, lay sliced mozzarella on top of the pastry and return to the oven until melted and bubbling.
Warm the remaining demi glace and serve alongside the pastry parcel as a sauce.

notes.title: Wellington-Style
notes.content: This is a Wellington-style preparation — the veal is wrapped in pastry with the mushroom mixture and baked. The veal finishes cooking inside the pastry, so the initial sear should be brief.

notes.title: Demi Glace Sauce
notes.content: Demi glace is used both in the filling as a binder and served warm alongside the finished dish as a sauce. Prepare extra if you prefer a more generous pour.
